altText: Upright photograph of the Toitū Te Whenua Our Whakapapa exhibition panel headed 1990–1999, showing text and historical photographs.
caption: Toitū Te Whenua’s Our Whakapapa panel on 1990s geospatial work, including the DOSLI–LINZ transition and NZGD2000, photographed on 16 October 2026. Historical dates are separate from the photograph date.
dateDisplay: Historical panel period: 1990–1999; photograph taken: 16 October 2026
context: The 1990–1999 heading is the historical range described by the panel. Duane Wilkins photographed it on 16 October 2026. The existing record and timeline already document the DOSLI–LINZ split on 1 July 1996 and NZGD2000 implementation in 1998; the Landonline chapter covers its late-1990s planning and implementation. The panel also names Graeme Jupp in its topographic mapping account; his existing person record is retained. The panel photograph was taken on 16 October 2026; that is the capture date, not the date of the historical events described. The original JPEG is preserved unchanged; the full-size display and card variants apply EXIF orientation 6 without cropping.
derivativesNote: The supplied original JPEG bytes are retained unchanged under the source filename. Its EXIF Orientation 6 is applied to the full-resolution WebP and the card WebP; both keep the complete panel in frame without cropping. The original can be downloaded from this page.
